purpose: Offline frame replay (tools/frame_replay.md): one gi_hit_direct replay pack at S8 (static view), taken inside a 15 s rt_stats window so the live 'GI hit direct' / 'hit material' lines of the same frames are the replay's reference. Needs a layer + core build with the replay_pack writer (layer/replay.cpp, ABI 25) and its texture read (shaders/replay_image.hlsl). Texture budget (rp::fill_budget): the textures line measures every droppable image; the table images must all be kept.
